nom: The Ordinary Resveratrol 3% + Ferulic Acid 3% Antioxidant Serum for Brightening

avis.texte: Reservatrol is a recent addition to my anti-aging regiment and I am hooked. This serum goes on a little oily but it soaks right into my skin within minutes and I am left with hydrated and healthy skin for the day.
This is lightweight and absorbs very quickly, not oily. Does not pill and sits nice under makeup. I've noticed a difference!
I dont have sensitive skin and my skin barrier is super healthy and somehow this product gave me a terrible allergic reaction. Havent had one in yearssss!! Please be careful :(

My skin is very hardy and tolerates all kinds of products (including 1.0 Retinol), but there is something in this product that caused me to have a major reaction. Raised red and fleshy bumps, broken skin that scabbed over. Do a patch test first!
I love it, it leaves my skin soft and shiny, I use it with my cerave cream

I tried this a couple years ago and didn't notice great effects but I take resveratrol orally and *have* noticed good effects so I gave it another try. This time I followed the label carefully. I apply a small amount after water based treatments, before heavy oils and moisturizer, twice per day. Just 1-2 drops for the whole face. This, in combination w several products (incl GF from TO) has produced noticable improvements in pore size/texture, elasticity, clarity, and reduction in wrinkle depth. In 2 months it's taken years off my face, and it was the only thing I changed before adding GF a week ago. I was slathering this on by itself and I think it didn't absorb properly. PLUS the nmn and nac cream, peptides, and HA I use also help but they weren't doing much until I added this. The smell is like rubber bands but faint and dissipates quickly. I am 46, with very fair, dry, sensitive skin prone to rosacea.
Love it this is My first time using this product I will use it again I love it

Causes itching and irritation that dies go away. Slight facial peeling. 2 weeks inhave been using. Not sure if it works or should say helps. Yet. Just know about the itching and irritation . Also a little goes anling way.

Gifted by The Ordinary in exchange for an honest review. This serum was gentle on my sensitive, dry skin. Over the week I've used it so far, my skin feels firm and bouncy and well nourished. I love it!

This product is oily and sticky and even after an hour did not absorb into my skin. I tried to sleep on my back. The next day my skin was red and flaky- it took me a week to get back to normal. Skip this.

avis.titre: I can't wait to see results!
avis.texte: I have been using this for about 2 weeks now. I was surprised that it warms up when you apply it. It doesn't burn but just warm. My skin is starting to look less dull.

I am allergic to ingredients in almost ALL skincare, but NOT this one! Goes on warm and smells like a campfire, but absorbs quickly and scent disappears. Makes my very sensitive oily/combination skin SOFT & SUPPLE. My makeup and concealer glides on effortlessly, and my skin feels moisturized and smooth, without the shine. Thrilled with this product! I can't use moisturizer because it makes my face shiny and greasy, so this is an amazing alternative. P.S. Put this on BEFORE your Hyaluronic Acid, not after (or else the HA will pill-up on your skin.)

I use this daily in the am and before bed. Love the noticeable changes. Those complaining about being in the sun and etc. Research it. It states sensitivity to the sun. Has also been said not to use in the sun. Research before you complain. It works great if you use it the right way. Keeps my skin smooth and helped with my dark spots.

One or two drops after mild probiotic toner caused burning. Next day I had two red, flaking patches in each side of my face. Stopped using. Took 2 weeks to heal. Have not tried again. I'm sure it is the ferrulic acid. I've used other resveratrol products in the past with no irritation. My vitamin C product contains ferrulic acid and I can use it without irritation so kind of a mystery. Somehow I ended up with 2 bottles of this product and I can't use it. Maybe I can repurpose it somehow, but that seems kind of pointless.
I have no clue if this works because the stench of it revolts me. How are there so many positive reviews without any mention of the fact that your face ends up smelling like a hot dog?

I've been using this for 6 months now, at first I didn't know if there was a difference but I didn't use it for a couple weeks and started having more acne (I'm 6 months in with tretinoin, never really had acne before tret) and realized I hadn't been using this enough. Within a couple days of adding back in my skin tone has evened out and my acne is significantly calmer, too. It also seemed to help my skin after a mild sunburn, not positive though. I highly recommend though. I also use this to make my vit c serum using about a half scoop of the vitamin c powder, about 5-6 drops of marine hyluronics, and 2 drops of the resveratrol/ferulic acid and it works well.

avis.titre: AMAZING...but ONLY if your skin barrier is healthy
avis.texte: I used this product morning and night (1-2 drops) consistently for ~2 years with amazing results. Noticeably brightened my skin with the added bonus of a low price point and one bottle lasting for ages. However, after having a baby, my skin became more sensitive, and this product couldn't do its job under those conditions. It took me a good 6 months to realize that I should change my skincare routine, and at that point, I saw that my skin was less irritated when I didn't use this product (the primary culprit, however, was over-exfoliation). I tried to re-introduce this product around a year after changing my skincare routine, but it didn't seem to have much effect. However, when I recently re-introduced it again (I now have melasma and it's driving me nuts!), I noticed that my skin was responding positively right away. So bottom line: this product is absolutely AMAZING, BUT your skin barrier must be healthy enough to benefit. If this product doesn't work for you, or you suddenly can't tolerate it after a long period of use, consider a gentler skincare regimen and then try re-introducing it later; it's definitely worth trying because my skin hasn't been as bright without this product. I am SO happy that I can use it again!

avis.titre: Bad Skin Reaction from Expired Product
avis.texte: I am not sure if it's because the product expired or because of repeated exposure to the chemical but one morning I woke up with one of my eyes completely swollen shut and the skin red (the eye itself was totally fine). I didn't realize at first that it was the product but it happened a second time when it affected both eyes / eye regions; the skin on both my eye lids and on my cheek bones felt chemically burnt, were red and swollen. The swelling went away by the end of the day but the scab from the burn and swollen skin took days to heal and come off. I think this might have happened because of the product expiring - I ordered it a year ago and didn't realize since it lasted quite long and was stored in the fridge. I am tempted but too scared to try with a new bottle - overall I can't say I saw any significant improvment to my skin when I did use it anyway.
I have been using the product for about 3 weeks now, my skin is very soft, glowing and it has definitely helped with dark spots
Unfortunately, I tried this a year or so ago and it caused me to breakout in small pustules every time I used it. I had to discontinue :(

I haven't used this serum regularly, so I can't say anything about its effects. My only question is, if it's supposed to smell? I know Ordinary products tend to smell, but this really smells disgusting. So I just wanted to ask if that's normal, because no other comment mentioned it…
Its great for knees and elbows. It makes my skin feel soft, but it does irritate my face. I still love it though for my body.

This formulation is not suitable for combination/oily skin. My skin won't absorb this product no matter what. Same goes for pycnogenol. Please create an antioxidant formula suitable for ALL skin types

avis.titre: Can this be mixed with another anhydrous serum?
avis.texte: I would like to mix the serum with the 5% Pycnogenol serum in my morning routine. Since both are based on propanediol, my question now is whether I can apply them to the skin directly with the other and then work them in together

avis.titre: Can this be mixed with moisturizer?
avis.texte: I've used this for about a year. I do feel like it makes my skin flush and feel warm, but not in a irritating way. I'm not able to ask a question, so hopefully someone from TO replies...I don't use oil based products, can this be mixed with a moisturizer instead?

avis.titre: I cannot buy this product again.
avis.texte: This product made my face welp up turn red and it was hot to the touch and burned even after washing it off and 4 days later I still have dried skin peeling from the rash it gave me.
I like using this product but have recently been prescribed Tretinoin 0.5% and advised to keep other products to a minimum. Is it ok to use this in the AM (I use the Tret in PM)?

I like the idea that this serum protects against environmental damage, but I have the impression that it has been more damaging than beneficial to my skin. I usually apply it in the morning after cleansing, but before putting sunscreen on. Now, I don't know if this product is the culprit, but I noticed that when I stay outside for too long (couple hours) without a hat on, my skin becomes pinkish, feeling tight and itchy (a bit like a mild sunburn), despite always wearing sunscreen. It happens even in the middle of the winter when the UV index isn't high, especially when it's windy. Then it takes a couple of days for my skin to recover. I saw a few comments also mentioning that issue; does this serum increases UV sensitivity?
Much stronger than you realise. Don't use it without good Vit C suspension. Suffering consequences 🔥

I really like this serum as i feel it keeps fine likes away but i hate that its so oily. It takes a lomg time to absorb into the skin. I have to do my skincare routine at least an hour before putting makeup on because it takes so long to absorb. Other than that i think its a good serum. Wish it could be water based.

Combination skin , over 40. I started using it about 2 weeks now and my skin looks amazing. It feels at first a little tingling but after it's great. It feels at the first second oily but after 5 seconds it absorbs and matifies! I use it in the morning and after I do my make up which is a beautiful base. Best product ever… why I haven't tried yet. My skin couldn't tolerate Vit c in any form so my antioxidant is this product …

I just purchased my third bottle and I've been using it almost daily for 2 years. I'm 41 yrs old. It's the only ordinary product I use anymore. I mix a couple drops into other companies vitamin C serums. I've never enjoyed using is straight on its own. It tends to get warm. One bottle lasts a long time. I've never had any irritation. I have fairly sensitive and mildly acne prone skin that can be dry. I honestly can't say if this is the sole reason my skin has become more glowy or plump but it certainly doesn't hurt. And I know it boosts the effectiveness of vitamin C. And this is an extremely affordable way to achieve this result. Plus I can add it to whatever Vitamin C serum I have in my routine. One bottle lasts a very long time. 10/10

I only use a few of The Ordinary product and resveratrol+ferulic acid is one of them. I am a chinese so having asian skin tend to develop pigmentation plus i swim almost everyday and i hv to make sure to prep my skin bfr exposing myself to the sun. I use to keep the routine simple, just apply bfr moisterisure followed by sun screen. Now i mix it with my favourite emu oil. I once use The Ordnary vit C on my skin and had terrible burnt, it was tis carrier oil healed my skin leaving no marks behind and regaining my skin barrier all within 4 days. Now i jus want to continue and keep my routine simple.

I had such a severe reaction to this product that I discontinued using. I had to go to the doctor and get a prescription for an eczema-like condition, something I had never had before. As I bought double the amount, and it was some time ago, I no longer have the receipt. Not sure what to do with it now. I also used Niacinamide at the same time so I wrote the same review for that. Too scared to test it again to pinpoint which one it was but thinking this one as others seemed to have the redness I experienced. Scary!

avis.titre: Great to prep my skin for retionl
avis.texte: I started using this before my Granactive Retinoid 5%, I had read that this was a good mix. I love the feel of it on my skin. I leave it for 10 mins before I put on the retinoid. Then I finish it off with a NMF. My skin looks pretty good. Although I don't know if this is minimising the effects of the retinoid. Happy to have any advice on using it differently.
Hi. I was looking forward to the result but after 3 days, it made my skin so dry that it flaked off. Looks like I have wrinkles because of the dryness.

avis.titre: A great product but causes allergy reactions
avis.texte: I bought this product more than a month ago and I really wanted to love it. I tried so many way to make my skin love it for then a month but each time I keep getting an allergy reaction. the allergy reaction worsens when I use either the aha bha peeling solution or retinol in the same day. The weird thing is one side of my face loves it but the other side just hates it. I still have hope that maybe the ordinary will lower the dosage percentage and dilute it in Squalane

I was so hoping to love this and incorporate it into my nightly routine, but I can't stand the feel of it in my skin. I will try to use it up but I'm not sure I can handle it. It makes me want to wash it off right away.
Have used Resveratrol Ferulic Acid for a few months. Have seen no improvement in facial blood vessels. Its a very oily substance. Won't be buying again

I'm on my second bottle of TO resveratrol/ferulic acid. Unfortunately I developed an allergic reaction on my neck and upper chest resulting in a red rash and inflammation. I didn't use the serum on my neck with the first bottle. I will discontinue using the serum on my face too...I don't want to risk side effects.

This product was a total disaster for me. Within just three days of using it, my cheeks and forehead were covered in acne spots and the skin around my nose was dry and flaky. Also the fine lines under my eyes seemed bigger than usual because of skin dryness. I took a break from using it for two weeks to get my face back to normal, but when I gave it another try, the same thing happened all over again. I sure won't be using it again.
i have been using this daily with no problems. I am 60. Going to start mixing this with vitamin C powder that I just got. Will update.

I am from Asia meaning we have sunshine all year roung plus i swim in alternate days. I usually add this to my morning routine after hyaluronic acid serum, finished with ceraVe moisturiser. It keep my sun spots at bay. i use it on the back of my hand too. Please have it in bigger bottle.

I have been using it for about 2 years, and my skin looks amazing. Admittedly, although it's oilfree, the feel is greasy, especially if you apply too much; you can't just put it on and immediately apply makeup. Therefore, I apply it at night when I have ample time to let it sink into the skin. The next day, my skin is radiant, plump and clearer. This and the very similar pycnogenol (exact same comment, btw) are my favorite products. MUST BUY!

I have already used other products from the ordinary. The allergy test was negative. But after three days of use, acne and red spots suddenly appeared on my face. It all hurts and itches. I feel terrible.

Im 40 and have been using anti aging products for 10 years to prevent the signs of aging. This works great. My skin looks glowy and zero wrinkles. For those who say it burns, you need to stengthen your skin barrier. If you aren't using products that help with the skin barrier or have dry skin its going to burn. I've been using this for a year and never has it burned.

avis.titre: I liked until it started causing a reaction
avis.texte: I had been using this for about 6 months with vitamin C and started getting swollen red eyelids after about 5 months of using. I wasn't sure what was causing it so I eliminated everything and gave my skin a break for a while. I started adding back in, and it turns out to be this. I'd love to know if the ferulic acid is derived from oat or bran? I did like the product, and I don't think everyone will have this reaction obviously, but sadly it didn't work for me.

avis.titre: This in the morning...acids at night.
avis.texte: I see a lot of people complaining about irritation because they are using this in the same evening routine. STOP. retinol/acids in the evening. resveratol in the morning. You think with the internet at your fingertips people could figure this out. 🤔 . use this in the morning with a vit c and your moisturizer/sunscreen and retinol/acids at night to get best brightening effects.

avis.titre: Just started using it, I like it so far.
avis.texte: I use this after my Vit C serum and I got a little reddish on the face, I think it is powerful. I will continue using.

This product is absolutely amazing. I started using this during covid and wear almost every single morning during fall to spring. I use The Ordinary niacinamide 1st to help minimize my oil production and apply this on top using 3 droplets in my palms. I let this sit for a few minutes and proceed to apply an oil reduction moisturizer. This combination makes my skin have a beautiful glow ALL DAY long. I get compliments ALL the time. My skin is so smooth and firm. Can't believe the price point. Make sure you are wearing sunscreen. I also use a matte tinted sunscreen

This product is actually good. However using it straight always burns my face and when the episode calms down it does leave me with a bight complexion. What other product in your lineup can I dilute this with. I tried vitamin E oil but the Reveratrol + Ferulic settles at the bottom and when I forget to shake the bottle vigorously before taking a drop, my face would burn especially in my T zone. I love this product but I hate it as well. I need dilution options with same density oil in your lineup please.

I've been using this product every night for the past 5 days and I already see a difference! I woke up to smooth, even-looking skin! Even my boyfriend noticed (without me asking hehe). My skin is on the oily side so it's strictly PM use for me.

avis.titre: Good hydration, but leaves a shiny layer
avis.texte: A good addition to the regimen, but I only use it in the evening, since it doesn't dry down to a matte finish. I have dry to combination skin, but even the dry patches can't fully absorb the product. I have a question to TO. Can I use Resveratrol and Pycnogenol together, possibly even mix it during application? Thanks for your help.

Is it normal that when I use this product it feels like my face is burning after application? Otherwise I'm OK with it. That's why the 2 stars. I use it when I do my gua sha routine and like how my face/skin looks after it absorbs. I have dry skin so I like that it's a heavy oil formula. But I not gonna buy it again once I used it all.

I have so many contact allergies that I need to special order my toothpaste. no joke, it's so frustrating. TO resveratrol/ferulic is one of the few products I'm able to use and i definitely see improvement in my skin health from using it. i use this and the Argireline along with the natural Moisturizing factors and a cerave skin renewing night cream in the evening. these four products have transformed my skin in less than a month. everyone's skin is different though, and I see some others have had bad reactions to this product, but my sensitive skin loves it. it's brighter, the skin barrier has vastly improved, and my dry and rashy face is now clear and moisturized. if you find that you're having bad reactions, you may want to get a patch test done to see if you have any allergies so you can avoid them. there's a site called skinsafe you can put your allergies into and find products without them pretty easily.

avis.titre: Helps sunscreen blend, no noticeable skin benefits
avis.texte: I have been using this for 4 months. A little goes a long way- 3 drops for face and neck Light weight oil texture- comfortable and sinks in quickly. I do not notice any smell The best thing about this formula is that it stops my sunscreen pilling completely and makes sunscreen melt into skin quickly and more seamlessly. I have acne and hyperpigmentation, I have seen no noticeable improvement with this so far. I will be repurchasing for antioxidant support and for better sunscreen application and wear.

I have had a strict skincare regimen for years so I don't have wrinkles. So I can't say that it's working. However I bought it to keep wrinkles at bay. I started a new serum at the same time as this one but my skin really does look brighter, smoother, moisturized. I've had no reaction to it. It doesn't burn. I will continue to use it to prevent signs of aging since I'm now 40.

My favorite! I am using it every morning after Viitamin C 23% serum. It feels a little bit oily but after few minutes skin becomes so soft and shiny. I used to mix it with Vitamin C serum and water based gel cream but I stoped because I learn that water have negative effect on stability of this product. I think I will use it forever!

So I use the ordinary for most of my skincare other than cleanser. I just got a gua sha and needed a good serum that I could use with it. I thought this one would be good since it's an antioxidant serum and a bit on the oily side. I did not expect it to be as oily as it was. Then not 5 minutes after having it on my face, my acne started to burn. I'm not sure what ingredient messed with my skin but I will not be buying this again. That said, its worth a try and if it doesn't work you can return it. (I have combination skin)
This is the third bottle I've bought, I really like the way it makes my skin feel.

I never use Ordinary product before. This is the first time I use and try the Resveratrol 3% Serum. I am 50 and I begin having few long wrinkles on my forehead which I notice. After using the serum, I notice it is significantly lighter. I didn't take the before and after photo, sorry. I am so please of the serum and will order again for sure. Just want to mention that you may feel a bit tinkling or warm after you apply on your face and I feel that at the beginning but it will ease off after using more often. Also, I feel very oily after applying it. The best time to use will be before sleeping. Since I can work from home now, I apply in the morning too. It works out perfectly for me. I don't need to see anyone. =)

I use this Resveratrol serum after the vitamin C powder (that I mix with a little purified water and hyaluronic acid). I put about five drops of the resveratrol into some oil-free moisturizer and spread on my face and neck. I've noticed a big difference in my skin. Plump and healthy! Please don't ever stop making this stuff!

First of all I love this. I'm an esthetician but not working due to health issues so I have to buy cheaper skin care. I'm 39 and have been using products for aging skin for over 10 years to prevent wrinkles and lines. This product works as well as some professional ones. I want to address the comments that say it burns. Most of the time when a product burns and it's not a AHA or BHA it's because of dry skin, poor skin barrier or allergic reaction. In my opinion it's not the product's fault if your skin barrier is not as strong as it should be or you have an allergy to it. Almost everyone has an allergy of some kind. I'm allergic to bananas but don't give them a bad review on the grocery store website because I broke out in hives. There's nothing wrong with the product if you have an allergic reaction. It's because you're allergic to it. Many people are not. Plus side is now you know you're allergic to it and to avoid it in the future. Same if it burns. Moisturize with a quality moisturizer and buy a serum to repair your skin barrier. I use 30% glycolic acid on my face twice a month and it barely tingles. It's because my skin is moisturized and my skin barrier in good health. When my skin was very dry, it burned badly. Just a few tips to help with using skincare.

I use so many of The Ordinary products and I love them. This particular one though did not love me. I'm 51 and always trying new things in skincare. For months, I could not figure out which product was causing this as I had a bottle of oils mixed with my favorite carrier oils and the resveritrol in there as well. To a lesser degree than the picture I will post, it happened when I'd use the mixture. I gave up on the whole bottle. The other night I was going to bed and decided I'd use the resveritrol alone. It had a warming effect on my skin and I went to bed. I woke up to what you see in the picture. My eyes were swollen so badly. The redness, the burning feeling is awful. At least now I know what it was in the mixture I made that caused it because I used the resveritrol alone and woke to this. A steroid cream, hydrocortisone, Benedryl and slathering in Aquaphor, 3 days later it's still red but getting better.

avis.titre: Was absorption tested and is the data available?
avis.texte: Question: I know resveratrol is quite a large molecule and can be difficult to actually get into cells. Was the cell-uptake tested to show topical resveratrol can be absorbed or at what rate? Can absorption be increased or is that what the fertilícelo acid is for? Review: I have been using this for two weeks and while this is not enough time to see results, it has not caused any complications with my other products (vitamin c and adapalene).

I bought this because I thought it was supposed to improve the skin barrier and it does, but for me it does so much more than that. If I have a break out, I apply this and my skin looks better. If my skin is dry, I apply this and my skin looks better. If my skin is dull or red, this helps. Ive used Skinceuticals version and not only is this version cheaper but I like it better.

Used only ONCE normally and burned my skin and my face has been so dry and around my nose is so red and dry nothing I put on is helping. Made my skin flake burn itch for a week already only after one use. Please test out on small area first

Ordered a second bottle of this cause I really do think it helps plump up my skin and makes it hold moisture in better. It does go on slightly oily, but soaks right in. Oh, and you only need 4-5 drops to cover your whole face and neck, so don't use to much of it. Love this stuff.

Reservitrol and ferulic are amazing ingredients! I've been using them in skinceuticals long before people knew what they were and I always loved them but they're super expensive so when I saw this I knew I had to get. To be completely honest I wasn't expecting much but I was way off! This is not an oil though it feels like one. My tip is to get avene thermal water spray and after toning spray the water and apply this with your vitamin c… I use Allie's of skin 35% vitamin c… expensive but totally worth it and a tiny bit goes a long way… let it sit for a few minutes and then I spray a little bit more thermal water before I do my serum and this stuff is amazing during cold weather it keeps my skin so moisturized stops it from drying out I will always have back up bottles now and I will never switch back to the more expensive brand even if it was the same price because I love that this has both my ingredients in the same product and although some people don't like the application I actually love it because I know how to do it correctly and it really helps calm about the dryness from my tretinoin. This has been one of the product that has completely changed the look at my complexion my skin is bright and so even it looks clarified my pores look smaller there's just a complete change in my skin that I haven't seen in a very long time until I started using this and I know that this is one of the products in my cocktail that really helps my skin because when I don't use it there's su

Great product. I'm wondering if I can mix it with my Timeless 20% Vitamin C + Ferulic Acid serum or should I apply it right after the vit C? I've been doing both ways without any irritation but wondering which way is better
I love the entire The Ordinary line of products. They are all amazing. The resveratrol brightens your skin. Love it

avis.titre: Great product, but what about peptide mixing?
avis.texte: Im very happy with this serum! it moisturizes and protects my skin from oxidative stress, i didnt get any pimples, even tho my skin is prone to that, if it doesnt like some product. I have a question though. I wanted to include peptides in my routine (thought about buffet or buffet + copper peptides). I understand that copper peptides are tricky, but why cant i mix ferulic acid serum with other peptides? what would happen if i applied buffet serum and then ferulic acid serum 15 minutes later? if its very bad idea, then what anti-oxidants do u reccomend to use with buffet or buffet + copper peptides, so that they wont interact badly? i really want to use some anti-oxidant both in the morning and in the evening, but i also wanted to start using peptides at least once per day.

This is so underrated, literally gives the best possible results! Immediate I would say. After every night I use it, my skin looks so fresh and tight in the morning. Switching between this and retinol before sleep.

This serum changed my life the first day I used it. It goes on a little oily but soaks in in minutes. I'm 55 with sensitive acne prone skin. This doesn't aggravate my skin and cause breakouts or irritation. My skin looks smoother and this is just the first impression. This mixes really well with a zinc sunscreen.

I've been trying to figure out the perfect anti-aging regimen for my skin so I've been experimenting with lots of The Ordinary products over the past year. I have to say that this is one of my favorites!! My skin is very dry so i'm always looking for products that help moisturize without being too oily. This stuff makes my feel so hydrated and almost velvety. I use morning and night after putting on my other products. My morning routine = Marine Hyaluronics, Lactic Acid 5%, The Buffet...followed by a few drops Resveratrol & Ferulic Acid - which I let sink in for a few minutes then I finish up with Cera Ve cream. Night routine = Tretenoin followed up with a few drops Resveratrol & Ferulic Acid - which I let sink in for a few minutes then I finish up with Cera Ve cream. I've only been using for a few weeks and I feel that my skin texture had improved. My pores look smaller and overall I look more moisturized / dewy. I think it's important to remember that a little bit goes a long way with this product. I could see using too much as being too oily. I only use 3-4 small drops for my face and neck area each time. If you have dry skin I'd definitely recommend giving this a try!

avis.titre: Excellent alternative to Vit C serum
avis.texte: It's an anti oxidant serum that is incredibly cost effective compared to the expensive Vit C alternatives. Since Vit C is so unstable and one has to have a 20% concentration to be effective, the more reliable companies who make it are very costly. I'll definitely buy this again.
Not sure if I got a bad bottle or it just doesn't agree with my skin. But I woke up in the morning with a resemblance of a rash and bumps all over my cheeks. I was scratching at my face all day!

I kinda liked what it did to my small wrinkles and overall skin tone. BUT it did clog my pores like crazy. Congested skin all over my jaw line and cheeks, forehead even. I was testing this for about 2-3 months and I'm giving up now. Pycnogenol is the love of my live and I shouldn't try to change that lol.

avis.titre: BEWARE OF ULTA--may not be the pure product!
avis.texte: I have been using this product for over a year with great results. The last bottle I bought from Ulta has caused HORRIBLE reactions for me, though. I bought a bottle about 6 months ago and I would apply it at night--as usual--under my moisturizer. I woke up the next morning with swollen, puffy eyes and irritated red skin on my upper cheekbones/under eye area. It took like a full week for the skin to properly heal. I was trying to figure out if I was doing something wrong--like mixing the wrong anti-aging acids--so I would eliminate products one by one, but I'd still get the same reaction. I went weeks between trials. But I just tried this again on its own as a solo product last night, and I woke up to the same eyes swollen-shut and red skin! I'm assuming something else was placed in the bottle. I'm not sure if it's The Ordinary---I kind of think it's Ulta doing this because in this same shipment, I received a used Anastasia Brow Wiz pencil with the crayon completely missing.

avis.titre: I really wanted to love it!
avis.texte: I got it around a month ago and carefully introduced it to my skincare routine after patch testing. I can't really explain why exactly but it made my skin felt smooth and moistured directly after I started using it, it was glowing and looked so fresh! BUT I started noticing some itchy bumps that were developing on my checks and forehead that were really hard to get rid of.. so I started using it on only one side of the face, and these bumps slowly disappeared from the other side. Sadly I had to stop using it at all (as my wedding is soon and I want to look as good as possible). Besides these strange allergy this product is wonderful! My skin looked really wake and alive. I don't know why exactly I developed such a reaction and hope maybe someday in the future I could use it again to get all the benefits.

i've only been using this for around a month but wow, my skin feels so healthy and fresh. I mix this with vit C in the morning and retinol at night. I noticed that my skin literally drank the mixture lol. Gonna use this up and give y'all an update!

I have been using this nightly for 2 weeks under a low cost peptide cream with a basic seaweed moisturizer. The results are phenomenal. I like the warming sensation and it absorbs quickly on my dry skin. I've tried dozens of actives and retinols and this combo is a winner!

avis.titre: Can anyone explain the sun sensitivity?
avis.texte: I liked what this did for my skin, no irritation or redness at home and I only used at night. However on the first day of real sunshine here I went out and was bright pink after only half an hour outside even under a thick thick layer of SPF50+. I get the same thing when I'm using the ordinary vitamin C - bright pink skin after sun exposure that makes me look like I've been boiled. Looked it up and I just get "anti oxidants are UV protective" and "make sure you use sunscreen", which I knew anyway, so I'm confused, but this product seems to cause a great deal of photosensitivity for me. I checked other reviews and didn't see anything about sun sensitivity so hopefully this helps some people.

I was so skeptical of this one because I didn't quite understand what it does. I use 1 drop during the day with Ascorbic acid + alpha arbutin and 2 drops at night with .5 Retinol in Squalane. This tiny little drop seems to amplify the effects of the other serums. Will always repurchase this!
Another great serum to add to your regimen. The Ordinary offers so many different serums and you can come up with a cocktail that works for your skin's needs.

avis.titre: Additional information to my recent review
avis.texte: I should have included in my former review, that I also use the Buffet w/copper peptides and Niacinamide together in my PM routine. This combination has dramatically improved the size of my pores and helped with texture. I'm quite impressed with this skincare line.

avis.titre: The Ordinary should label this as Beauty Oil!
avis.texte: I started using this together with my Vitamin C serum and Vitamin E in the AM about 3 weeks ago and my skin absolutely loves this combination! I noticed relatively quick that my skin looked fresh, hydrated and plump. My husband asked me the other day what I was doing differently, as my face looked extremely soft and glowy. That in and of itself is proof positive that I wasn't imagining what I was seeing in the mirror!

avis.titre: So, I'm 46, do not have sensitive skin but...
avis.texte: My skin has felt dry and been burning and I was trying to figure out why. Slight sunburn? A bit windburn? Nope. This! I love The Ordinary products except for this one. It burns my skin and even the next day it feels dry and tight after washing my face. Gotta remove this from the line up. I still love the rest of my Ordinary products though.

avis.titre: Feels great on skin.. kind of smells like beef?
avis.texte: I just started using this with vitamin C cause i heard they good together in the morning and feel great on my skin together! it goes on very smooth and absorbs well. However, it has a meaty / beefy smell? Is that normal for resveratrol or ferulic acid??? or this serum? im willing to look past the smell but it took me guard the first few times i used it...

I really like how this improves my sensitive red skin. It also has improved the texture of my skin. It has also balanced out my skin and I love the new youthful glow. I was just wondering how do you use it with one of your retinols?

avis.titre: Best product I've tried for cystic acne!
avis.texte: Listen, I have been using the Ordinary products for a decade now. When I first started, the items I've picked didn't work for me. Rosehip and NMF broke me out, Niancinamide made my skin red and itchy, and hyaluronic acid provided me no hydration. This time, I did more research on the items. THIS serum made the biggest difference in my skincare. I use it during the morning 2-3 drops mixed with Ascorbic Acid 8% and Alpha Arbutin 2%. At night, I apply this after my tretinoin (this is safe to do so). Holy wow, in less than a month, my acne scars have been shrinking and fading. Even niancinamide, glycolic acid, and Ascorbic Acid with consistent use over several months did not fade my scars, nor reduce my cystic acne. I will forever buy this. The research on Resveratol is very interesting too, and backed up. Not sure about Ferulic acid. Morning: Amino Acid + B5 -> Ascorbic Acid 8% + Alpha Arbutin 2% mixed with Resveratrol and FE Night: Amino Acid + B5 --> (wait 10 minutes)-> Tretinoin 0.025% --> (wait 15 minutes) -> Resveratrol and FE mixed with 'B' oil from the Ordinary

I want to love this product but it made me break out so bad and i want to make sure it was this product and not other one i had add to my routine so i stop using the other product and continue using this one and my break outs got worse i stop and give it another try once my skin was better and same story so i stop using it and it went in the trash . My skin has been looking better since i stop using this product .
Its a good product but I need to give it a chance. I don''t use it often but now that may change.

avis.titre: Not the most cosmetically elegant but STRONG antioxidant
avis.texte: This isn't the most comfortable or fun to apply serum in the world but I still give it 4 stars because it combines two of the most scientifically proven and strong antioxidants that aren't as easy to find at this price point. I also like the minimal formula. It's very straightforward. Yes, it's a little greasy since the carrier is propanediol which is essentially an emollient (feels oily). To solve this you can add a couple of drops into your moisturizer. This helps it absorb a little bit better into the skin as opposed to applying it to plain skin. Plus, remember, you won't be applying a ton of this product (2-3 drops max) like a normal serum so this method makes it easier to apply and spread. I really do think those who think this serum is greasy will enjoy this product a LOT better by mixing it with other skincare products. You can also try mixing it with other serums; but try mixing in the palm of your hand to see if they mix together well before you put it on your face. This product does seem to be a little hydrophobic (repels water) so it mixes together a little better with products that contain oil or emulsifiers. Most products contain emulsifiers so you should be good.

Used this product for the first time. I should have checked the ingredients more closely before buying. There are only three ingredients - resveratrol, ferulic acid, and the carrier, propanediol. It is not specified whether this ingredient comes from corn or petroleum. I don't think I've used this before in this quantity, but it goes on very thick and does not absorb into the skin. After waiting and putting on sunscreen, my skin feels heavy, sticky, greasy. There is also some irritation and stinging. I wish this product was more transparent about the source of this ingredient. I wouldn't purchase again

I use this with the Ordinary Pycnogenol to protect my skin. It's excellent and effective. I really wish the Ordinary would now make a 3 % CO Q10 serum to go along with the others. Or remake their Lipoic Acid serum too. These products are awesome but we also need a couple more antioxidants from the Ordinary to mix and match.
It's a good idea to test a patch first as this oil is intense until you build up some tolerance. It's too early to tell now how this works but I'm a fan of reservatrol so hopeful.
Propanediol is the vehicle for this non-water/non-oil(?) serum(?). Way too greasy for my combo skin, even in winter. Too bad b/c it's such a high % of resveratrol

avis.titre: Is it OK to continue using?
avis.texte: For the first time yesterday I used this product. It seemed fine but this morning I realised that my skin felt quite tight and when I looked in the mirror I could see the skin above my top lip has a couple of red blotches and feels a little lumpy. I used it directly on my skin without diluting and didn't put anything else on top or underneath the resveratrol. Can I dilute it with my matrixly 10% serum? I would like to continue using it if I don't have further problems and wonder if this is a one off problem for the first use?

avis.titre: Instant Brightening, Better than Vitamin C!!
avis.texte: I love this so much better than various vitamin C serums that I've tried (which produced little if any results)! This resveratrol serum goes on with a slippery/silicone, maybe slightly greasy feel, and produces a warming flush to the skin. All of that dissipates within just a few moments and my skin is left feeling smooth and hydrated, not greasy, and looking instantly brighter. I have 40+, somewhat sensitive and slightly dry skin, and haven't had any issues with this. I use 4-5 drops each morning, full strength, and apply to my face/neck/chest before a moisturizer and sunscreen. Great product!

avis.titre: Great alternative to Kiel's Ferulic Acid toner!
avis.texte: Are you kidding me? I've already purchased this twice. I got this as a replacement to a kiehl's lactic acid and ferulic acid toner, and its amazing. I usually alternate this with the 10% lactic acid from TO and my skin texture has become so smooth. I still get the occasional hormonal acne or if I'm not drinking enough water, but I use this at night and my pimple is very much reduced in the morning. I also have combo skin, in the summers its oily but in the winter it gets kinda dry. I probably wouldn't have tried it if it wasn't for the expensive one that I didn't want to purchase, but this actually turned out to be a great alternative. This is a must try if you want hydration but also clearer skin. I don't think I would recommend this to people with oily skin since this is a very oily serum.

avis.titre: My skin condition is in remission!
avis.texte: I have perioral dermatitis (not caused by steroids). I actually expected this product would exacerbate the condition, but instead it's dramatically improved my skin and my dermatitis is nearly unnoticeable. I use 2 drops twice a day after hydrating serum and before creams. Does not sting or irritate my sensitive skin, no redness and sinks down quickly. Will be stocking up and buying more as gifts.

I have been using Resveratrol for only 8 days and I have to say that I am amazed at how different my skin is starting to look. Due to hormonal changes, my hyperpigmentation from acne is fading fast. As the directions state, it should be mixed with other treatments to enhance its antioxidant capacity, I am mixing it with a Vitamin C brightening Serum to enhance it and it is doing its job. I am loving this product!

I wanted to like this a lot because I wanted some type of brightening serum since I can't afford the one I want. It gets warm when I apply it to my face and for some reason it just sits on top of my skin. Haven't seen results from using it but i'll continue and finish it although I'm not satisfied

I purchased this based on the reviews. I don't have sensitive skin. In fact, my skin can take a beating. I've never had a skin reaction to anything, ever! I used this tonight and immediately started feeling a bit of stinging. I thought it would go away. After awhile, I still felt the stinging so I got up to look. My face was covered in hives and a rash. I immediately started to wash everything off, double cleansed in fact. This stuff is strong. I will not be using this again.

Patch test this first and dilute!! Used this for years diluted, but I decided to use it alone just to experiment with it and I had a major allergic reaction that made my skin itchy red and burn. Weird because I don't have dry or sensitive skin, and this has never happened before, so I'm guessing it can happen to anyone if you're not careful! Def learned my lesson lol

avis.titre: One of my Ordinary TOP Faves
avis.texte: I combine this with Vitamin C Suspension 23% + HA Spheres 2% as my night skin care and my skin is so thankful for it. I've been using it for over a year now and my skin texture and tone never looked better. I have a very dry skin, so I usually apply moisturizers before this. I just can't believe how much my skin quality improved over one year. It has mild oily texture but it's not too thick. It also has a subtle heating sensation rightg after applied, which I love! I tried out almost all Deciem products, some of them are part of my skincare routine. This one is on the top of my shelf.

This might just be my favorite ordinary product it works best for me and has shown the most instant results of course at first i was a bit annoyed with the drying effect just add moisturiser on top but wow the plumping blurring and acne fighting effects really outweigh any cons for me, I've been struggling with acne for 15 years now after failed accutane treatments and literally burning my skin with benzoyl peroxide for years now, i found this product and it is gentler and more hydrating while combating all of my issues clogged pored uneven tone annoying white and black heads and active spots, I'm on my forth bottle now i stuck with it because i could see the benefits literally a few hours after application, i stopped using it for a while played around with some organic plant based stuff that broke me out so went and got 2 more bottles, after 2 days of use i can already see it repairing the damage the other products have done to my skin, i had about 24 ordinary products in my drawer at some point some didn't really work or were a lot of hassle to use but if i were to chose it's this I'll continue repuchasing and the squalane oil cause i use it on my hair as well even on my dogs hair it works wonders and ofc the foundations, the moisturiser is really good too, i used to layer up 5-6 products in my routine it was a hassle and never knew which one worked best now I'm trying a simpler aproach to test the ordinary range and so far this product is my favourite.
I bought this to mix with the ascorbic acid powder. I have been using it for about a month now and absolutely LOVE it! My skin is brighter and the tone is more even.

I love the way this looks under my sunscreen, it gives a beautiful, healthy glow. I'm still waiting on the benefits but I know these are well-studied ingredients so I don't doubt their efficacy. My only beef is that it is very greasy on the skin. I use two drops and spread them over my entire face. You need to let it "dry down" before applying sunscreen which is a pain because it takes some time. I live in a dry climate and have normal skin, but I can't imagine how this works if you have oily skin or live in a very humid environment. You might become a grease ball.

I stupidly added the new product soon after starting another Deciem product. My skin had a terrible reaction; sunburn, peeling, etc. Stopped everything and treated with a topical steroid prescribed by my derm. Tested this product on its own; without any actives only a moisturizer. Couple hours later; I looked sunburned and felt sunburned. Would not recommend.

With mature and post-menopausal skin, getting my hands on 3% resveratrol for next to nothing was a no-brainer. The propandiol makes it feel greasy, but will absorb completely in under 1 minute. Typically, I add it to my nightly retinol oil or peptide serum. My skin is less sensitive, ruddy, and reactive. My skin is 100% smoother. Well done!
Excellent skin texture product. The price point is terrific. Mind the application instructions so one doesn't negate positive benefits by countering with another product.

avis.titre: Use with VC powder and Skin Oil with VE
avis.texte: Be surprised if use the way I suggested in the title - I usually apply the mixed portion with my sunscreen and love the side effects that it really even out skin tone from inside. No dullness or uneven tone. Love it.

I'm very turned off with the texture of this serum. Sticky/greasy like pure glycerin. I have dry skin and zinc spf is always hard to use, and this serum made it worse. I used 1 drop of serum(its greasy) and put zinc over it and it pills. The serum seems better under chemcial spf. I've read quite a few reviews about irritation from this, even after using it for awhile. Hope that doesnt happen either.

avis.titre: My skin is so soft and moisturized
avis.texte: I bought this 4 days ago to add to my simple acne routine. I have struggled with cystic acne for 5 years now and this product is a God-send, especially paired with a benezoyl peroxide cream. My skin cleared up literally within 2 days on this.

No puedo estar más feliz de haber comprado este producto, limpio mi cara, la humedezco un poco y aplico el ácido hialurónico, luego mezclo un hidratante en gel con el polvo 100% L-ascorbic, y termino con el resveratrol y mi masajeador eléctrico, esto es realmente una maravilla, espero que lo sigan sacando porque yo lo seguiré comprando por siempre! Gracias Deciem!

This combined with the L-ascorbic wow my skin is unreal at the minute. I have suffered with melasma hyperpigmentation on my upper lip since the birth of my kids and this and the vit c have lightened it, also I suffer with awful dry skin around nose and eyebrows and it's now disappeared. Skin looks like I've had Botox haha.
Really helps brighten my complexion and hydration. I mix a couple of drops with the moisturising factors goes on like a dream. I have extremely acne prone skin and have had no problems.

avis.titre: It's not good product for my skin. Irritation!
avis.texte: After 1 weeks I can't use this product more because I got some strong allergy:-(
